text:
Maxim Shabanov went undrafted, scored 67 points for Traktor Chelyabinsk in the KHL in 2024-25, and got 44 games with the Islanders last season. In Minnesota he has become something else: a power-play finisher. He's on the ice for 72% of the Wild's power-play chances, up from 27%, and nine of his 14 points have come with the extra man.

Our numbers call it a breakout, with his own chances up to 0.82 expected goals per 60 from 0.62. The finishing is the part to watch: nine goals on 5.1 expected, shooting 24% after 9% last season. That rate rarely lasts. At five on five the picture is weaker, 46% of the expected goals with him on and 7.7 points worse than without him, so the power play is doing the lifting. He breaks the puck out cleanly, though, 77% of his exits with possession in Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking. He ranks 79th in the league in wins added by goals. Our range projects 34 to 53 points and 16 to 26 goals.
